title: 2025 Kia Niro Collision Repair and Quarter Panel Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair completed collision repair and quarter panel replacement on a 2025 Kia Niro in Vancouver, WA.
story: This 2025 Kia Niro arrived with severe damage along the right passenger side. The collision crushed both doors and tore the outer body paneling near the rear wheel arch. The side structure required careful disassembly and measurement before sheet metal fitting could begin.

Technicians replaced the damaged rear quarter panel and addressed structural distortion along the passenger side door openings. Proper alignment was verified to maintain factory body lines, door latch clearance, and weather seals.

Following panel replacement, the new metal was prepped, primed, and sprayed with a factory-matched green finish. After curing and clear coat polishing, the trim, door handles, and taillight assemblies were reinstalled.
